name: 预算执行汇总查询
description: 按预算汇总已执行金额与执行率
statement: SELECT b.budget_no, b.budget_name, b.project_no, b.total_amount, SUM(d.exec_amount) AS executed, ROUND(SUM(d.exec_amount) * 100.0 / b.total_amount, 2) AS exec_rate FROM 预算主表 b LEFT JOIN 预算明细表 d ON b.budget_no = d.budget_no GROUP BY b.budget_no
